name: Resume
source:
[i]Best you face her sooner rather than later, you suppose. What’s the worst that could happen, anyway?[/i]

Resume is a visual novel set in a 2D club space and taking place in a post pandemic world. It captures a feeling, a specific moment, as after months of being stuck at home you finally head out to a party and are forced to navigate difficult relationships with your friends. It's a game about connections, crushes, queer relationships and how other people influence us.

[From [url=https://antolsz.itch.io/resume]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]看来，你最好尽早去见她。反正最坏又能坏到哪里去？[/i]

《Resume》是一部以疫情后的世界为背景、发生在二维俱乐部空间里的视觉小说。它捕捉了某个特定时刻的感受：在家困了数月后，你终于出门参加派对，却不得不面对与朋友之间错综复杂的关系。这是一个关于联结、暗恋、酷儿关系，以及他人如何影响我们的故事。

[来源：[url=https://antolsz.itch.io/resume]itch.io[/url]]
